_note: Project profiles (WORKORDER_01 section 5). A profile is data. Tool sets are four tools wide and deliberately exclude list_project_files and inspect_error: both return information the application already knows, so the file list and the last run result are injected as context instead. Phase 1 and 2 measured selection accuracy falling as the tool set grows. edit_file is the primary way to change a file; write_file is only for creating a new one. See SPIKES.md.
_note_starters: Schema 2 (Phase 11) replaced the single 'starter_template' string with 'starters' -- the kits this profile offers -- and 'starter_default' -- which of them a new project begins with. A default of null means the project begins empty, and a profile may offer no kits at all. The schema allows a starter; it does not require one. Each id names a directory under opennest/projects/starters/ carrying a starter.json manifest (opennest/projects/starters.py).

profiles.name: Website
profiles._packages_note: None. A first website is files a child can read, not a toolchain: no React, no Node, no npm, no bundler and no build step. Section 6 of the Phase 11 work order.
profiles._run_mode_note: The only 'preview' profile. A website is not executed -- there is no process, no exit code and nothing for the process sandbox to confine, because the files are the thing. Open Nest opens the page itself with every non-file request refused (opennest/execution/web_preview.py), which is how section 17's 'works offline, no trackers, no CDN' becomes enforced rather than merely asked for.
profiles._tools_note: Three, and deliberately no preview tool. Gary cannot see the rendered page any more than he can see a picture, so giving him a button that claims to look at it would be the section 13 honesty problem in a new costume. He edits the files; the child looks.

profiles.name: Arduino
profiles._entrypoint_note: arduino-cli requires a sketch folder whose name matches its .ino, so the sketch is src/project/project.ino and not src/project.ino. Measured in SPIKES.md section 14: the flat layout fails with 'main file missing from sketch: src/src.ino'.

profiles.name: Image Creation
profiles._starters_note: prompts.md is not schema filler. prompts/image_creation.txt tells Gary to keep it current -- 'when a description works, write it down with the file it made' -- so the file is the one thing this profile's system prompt depends on existing.
profiles._run_mode_note: The only 'generate' profile. Generation is an application action, not a project run: the process sandbox denies network, so a child's own code could never reach an image service. Nothing here is executed, which is why run_command and compile_command are both null.
profiles._image_model_note: The image model lives here rather than in models.json on purpose: a models.json entry is something that answers a conversation, and this one does not. PLAN.md decision D6.

profiles.name: Something Else
profiles._starters_note: None, and null. Section 7 of the Phase 11 work order: Blank stays genuinely blank. The Phase 0 blank_basic kit was withdrawn rather than left offered -- a profile whose whole purpose is an empty page should not have a starter to decline. entrypoint is still main.py because that is the path run_command targets once there is something to run.
